scope: Governance for versioned APOIS Edge Function copies. This file changes ownership/provenance only; it does not change runtime or financial behavior.

roots.purpose: Release-policy overlay. Contains fail-closed provider stubs and selected current release implementations classified by docs/edge-function-release-classification.json.
roots.pipeline: Validated by verify:retired-provider-source and verify:edge-function-source-of-truth. Deploy only explicitly selected slugs; never use an unqualified deploy-all from this mixed-project overlay.

roots.purpose: Canonical upstream implementation source for the Entregas Supabase project, except where the current Superapp release overlay explicitly supersedes a slug.
roots.pipeline: Pinned submodule -> .work/entregas for application build. Superapp build does not deploy Supabase Functions; backend deploy is explicit per slug from the approved source/release overlay.

roots.purpose: Canonical source for Corridas passenger-only Edge Functions. Also retains historical copies of shared slugs that must not be treated as deployment authority when a shared owner is declared below.
roots.pipeline: Pinned protected submodule -> .work/corridas for passenger build/hardening. The passenger deployment runbook is historical/manual; Superapp CI forbids treating overlapping shared slugs as implicit deploy-all authority.

roots.purpose: Canonical upstream source for Corridas shared and driver/admin Edge Functions when the same slug also exists in the passenger snapshot, unless the current release overlay supersedes it.
roots.pipeline: Pinned protected submodule -> .work/motorista for app build. Backend deploy is explicit per slug; overlapping Corridas slugs use this root as source authority unless release policy points to the release overlay.

sameProjectDuplicatePolicies.purpose: These are same-project duplicate slugs/files. The passenger repository keeps a protected snapshot used by its application build, while the shared/driver backend owns overlapping upstream implementations. Retired financial slugs may be superseded at release time by the fail-closed release overlay.
sameProjectDuplicatePolicies.pipeline: Never run an unqualified deploy-all from either Corridas source. Deploy an overlapping slug only from corridas-driver-admin, or from release-overlay when the release classification marks the provider endpoint retired/fail-closed.

canonicalAssignments.purpose: Current release policy retires Mercado Pago webhooks and requires fail-closed behavior.
canonicalAssignments.pipeline: verify:retired-provider-source -> explicit release deploy of the classified slug only.

canonicalAssignments.purpose: Current release policy retires provider-backed driver payout endpoints and requires fail-closed behavior.
canonicalAssignments.pipeline: verify:retired-provider-source -> explicit release deploy of the classified slug only.

canonicalAssignments.purpose: Current release policy retires electronic cancellation-fee charging and requires fail-closed behavior.
canonicalAssignments.pipeline: verify:retired-provider-source -> explicit release deploy of the classified slug only.

canonicalAssignments.purpose: Shared dispatch/push function used by the Corridas backend; duplicate passenger copy is a protected snapshot, not deploy authority.
canonicalAssignments.pipeline: Explicit per-slug Corridas backend deploy from corridas-driver-admin after source-of-truth verification.

canonicalAssignments.purpose: Current non-financial release implementation versioned in the integration overlay.
canonicalAssignments.pipeline: Release-integrity verification -> explicit per-slug deployment for Entregas.

canonicalAssignments.purpose: Passenger-only account deletion function; no same-project duplicate exists in the driver/admin source root.
canonicalAssignments.pipeline: Explicit per-slug Corridas backend deploy from corridas-passenger.

canonicalAssignments.purpose: Only versioned Corridas copy at the pinned HEAD.
canonicalAssignments.pipeline: Explicit per-slug Corridas backend deploy from corridas-passenger after authorization review.

canonicalAssignments.purpose: Passenger ride-request router; the Superapp passenger workspace invokes this slug and no same-project duplicate exists in driver/admin.
canonicalAssignments.pipeline: Passenger source -> .work/corridas build validation; explicit per-slug Corridas backend deploy from corridas-passenger.

canonicalAssignments.purpose: CORS helpers are source-tree-local dependencies, not standalone deployables. The Corridas shared backend helper is authoritative for shared/driver functions; other roots intentionally keep their own helper semantics.
canonicalAssignments.pipeline: Bundled transitively with the explicitly selected Edge Function source; never deployed or synchronized globally as a standalone artifact.
